WWE invades the United Kingdom for this exciting pay-per-view event. Held annually in England, Rebellion showcases the very best WWE Superstars of the Attitude Era. Storied bouts never broadcast in the United States include Kurt Angle defending the WWE Championship against "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Rikishi and The Rock in a fatal four-way match, WWE Champion Brock Lesnar teaming with Paul Heyman to face Edge in a handicap match and The Rock and "Stone Cold" Steve Austin taking their legendary rivalry overseas.
